text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The rose of dawn saw its spring end midway 
to its goal. However—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Generations later, a new bloom unfurls at 
last! Aiming for the unseen kingdom of 
roses!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Here I come, Ruler! Hyaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The Kingdom of the Rose, huh... Heh, but I 
have one too――

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"If it's a 'kingdom' we're aiming for, 
I've got one! Daaaaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: What... !?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A race where both were intensely conscious 
of each other. It was, without a doubt, a 
world belonging solely to the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa... As expected of one who 
descends from the "Empress"...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still, tell me, Ruler. What kind of 
kingdom are you truly striving for...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't call it a kingdom, but... Like 
I said, I've got my own reasons too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"You see, I want to compete in a 'fair' 
world."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: A "fair" field?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yes, reality is, for the most part, not 
fair.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Some matches are decided before they even 
begin. However—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The world of board games is different. 
Anyone can participate, and everyone has a 
chance at victory.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"And everyone enjoys the competition. 
I—simply love a world like that to death."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I hope the Twinkle 
Series can be such a world as well."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
While I'm at it becoming the ruler, if I 
also instill the culture I desire—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I predict that one day, the Twinkle Series 
will become a kingdom of pure joy, just 
like an esports tournament.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: A kingdom... of ecstasy...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to run out of obligation; I 
want to purely enjoy winning and losing. 
And—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Rose, you weren't able to run in the Arima 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...And?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The biggest buzzkill at a gaming 
tournament is when someone has to forfeit 
due to an accident.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A board game is supposed to be fair from 
the start. A game where you're guaranteed 
to lose right out of the gate is just pure 
trash.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That's why I came here: to make sure the 
fair match I desire actually happens.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
How was it, Rose? Facing off against me. I 
had a blast, but did it fire you up too?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Ah—very much so.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, there's an established theory in the 
board game world: "A 2-player board game 
that's fun is a great game."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series is... a good game.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, exactly. And precisely because it's 
a good game—"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I want to compete with even more friends 
once again.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ruler, let's meet next at the spring Grand 
Prix, the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I shall make sure to be there. 
—My deepest gratitude for your courtesy 
call today.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let us settle this. Who shall become 
the next ruler?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A kingdom of ecstasy. Perhaps those words 
were spoken purely on impulse. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership and I want the same thing: to 
enjoy a thrilling contest, just like 
playing a board game.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oho, those two... so nice! Did you hear 
that exchange just now?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was thrilling! Especially what 
Rulership said...
The Twinkle Series is... a good game...
Quote of the day! Lemme jot that down...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I feel like I always see them at the 
racetrack. Do they love racing that much, 
or could it be...?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about that, Trainer. Thanks for 
putting up with my solo play. However—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Both Rose and I had a great time. She 
headed home with a smile on her face, 
after all."
choice_data_list: Yeah, the crowd was going wild too!
Yeah, the crowd was really hyped up too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I don't really need to talk about 
the Umamusume in the stands..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next is the Takarazuka Kinen, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I just can't shake this nagging doubt... 
Can I truly prove myself the strongest 
ruler just by following standard 
convention...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I want to find a catalyst somehow and 
bring about a paradigm shift, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To prove that she was the absolute, 
undisputed ruler. Rulership's quest 
continued on.
